summary.name: MJML App
summary.one_liner: A desktop app for writing, live-previewing and test-sending responsive MJML email templates.
use_cases: Build responsive HTML emails with live preview
Import and manage MJML email templates
Test how emails look on mobile, desktop and browser clients
Send test emails to your inbox from the app
summary.what_it_does: The MJML App is the official desktop application for the MJML email markup language. It lets you import and manage templates, edit emails with live rendering, and customize your environment. The preview pane updates as you code and can be resized to check responsive behaviour. The app supports all MJML features out of the box. It can send test emails directly to your inbox using a Mailjet account and API keys, so you can view the result on mobile, desktop and browser clients. A presets section lists community templates, and contributors can submit templates via pull request.
notable: Live preview that re-renders as you code and resizes to show responsive behaviour
Sends test emails straight to your inbox via Mailjet
Presets section of community MJML templates
caveats: Test email sending requires a Mailjet account with API keys and a valid sender and recipient address
Listed as freeware on awesome-mac, but the page itself does not state pricing
